claims.text: At stage-3 Insets.tile is EdgeInsets.all(Space.md) (Space.sm 8, Space.md 12) and StatusBanner uses Insets.tile as its padding; status_banner_test.dart checks the message text, the action tap and the background color, not the padding value of the Padding widget.
STAGE.md at stage-3 tells Windows and macOS users to run `flutter test --exclude-tags golden`; golden images are made on Linux (ubuntu-24.04) and compared only there.

flutter test --tags <tag> runs only tests with that tag; --exclude-tags <tag> skips them; plain `flutter test` runs tagged tests too; tags are set on a test file with @Tags([...]) before `library;`, and declared in dart_test.yaml under `tags:`.
claims.source_hint: Flutter CLI `flutter test --help` (--tags, --exclude-tags); package:test README 'Tagging tests' and doc/configuration.md 'tags'

claims.text: matchesGoldenFile(key) compares the rendered image of the found widget with a golden file; with the default LocalFileComparator the path is resolved relative to the test file, and any pixel difference fails the test.
claims.source_hint: Flutter API flutter_test matchesGoldenFile, LocalFileComparator (basedir = test file directory, compare: exact match); docs 'Golden file testing' in flutter_test

claims.text: `flutter test --update-goldens` makes matchesGoldenFile write the current image to the golden file instead of comparing with it.
claims.source_hint: Flutter API flutter_test matchesGoldenFile ('flutter test --update-goldens'); autoUpdateGoldenFiles

claims.text: Flutter's documentation warns that text (fonts) can render differently on different platforms, so a golden image made on Windows will likely differ from one made on Linux.
claims.source_hint: Flutter API flutter_test matchesGoldenFile / goldenFileComparator docs (platform differences in rendering)

claims.text: When a golden comparison fails, LocalFileComparator writes the master image, the test image and diff images into a `failures` folder.
claims.source_hint: Flutter API flutter_test LocalComparisonOutput / generateFailureOutput (failures/ directory, _masterImage, _testImage, _isolatedDiff, _maskedDiff)

claims.text: At stage-3 ci.yml runs `flutter test` in DonHang.App on ubuntu-24.04 (golden tests included) and, on failure, uploads DonHang.App/test/**/failures/ as the artifact golden-failures (if-no-files-found: ignore).
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-3: .github/workflows/ci.yml:77-89 (and the app job's runs-on)

claims.text: components_golden_test.dart loops over galleryExamples (8 entries) and Brightness.values (light, dark): 16 testWidgets named '<example> (<brightness>) looks as approved', each comparing find.byKey(frameKey) with goldens/<name>_<brightness>.png via await expectLater.
exampleFrame (shared with the accessibility test) builds the entry with buildTheme(donHangBrand, brightness), on the theme's surface, in a 360 x 160 SizedBox inside a RepaintBoundary keyed frameKey.
matchesGoldenFile is an asynchronous matcher (it reads/writes a file), so it is used with await expectLater, which lets the test wait for it, rather than expect.
dart_test.yaml at stage-3 declares the tag golden with the description 'Compares widgets with images made on ubuntu-24.04.'

update-goldens.yml: on workflow_dispatch only; job on ubuntu-24.04 in DonHang.App runs `flutter test --tags golden --update-goldens`, uploads test/design/goldens/ as artifact goldens, and commits nothing.
A workflow_dispatch workflow runs only when started by hand, for example from the Actions tab with 'Run workflow', choosing the branch (also possible via GitHub CLI or REST API).
claims.source_hint: GitHub Docs Actions: 'Manually running a workflow'; 'Events that trigger workflows' workflow_dispatch

claims.text: GitHub can show a changed image beside its previous version (2-up by default, also swipe and onion skin).
claims.source_hint: GitHub Docs 'Working with non-code files' > 'Viewing differences' (images)

claims.text: A failing golden test is a signal that the look changed, not proof of a bug; whether to regenerate depends on whether the change was intended, judged from the failure images first.
When goldens are compared on one platform (Linux CI), they should also be generated there, not on developers' Windows/macOS machines.

At stage-3 DonHang.App/test/design/goldens/ holds 16 PNG files, <entry>_<light|dark>.png for the 8 gallery entries, from loading_view_dark.png to status_banner_warning_light.png; text in them shows as solid blocks (flutter_test's default test font).
git switch --detach <tag> checks out the tag's commit without a branch.
